gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-asap: Asap keeps its body tight to the capitals, with open arcs on its c. Asap Sans aside, Outrun Future is the one that holds a wide-set outline you can trace like a single thread, big and synthwave-loud.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-supreme: Wide-spaced and a bit theatrical, Metamorphous sets a high midline and a gentle fat-to-slim stroke. Supreme follows in crisp sans-serif, its letters held open and its text forming a dense, heavy-looking strip.
gen-gf-oxanium-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a big x-height and steady pressure, every bend smooth and unobstructed. And Oxanium, with its monoline strokes and curves ending in clear daylight, would lose some of its command if shrunk down small.
gen-gf-paprika-manrope: Manrope reads bright, with a wide gap at the mouth of every curve and hardly any step between capitals and lowercase. Paprika scatters its letters apart with lowercase that fills the line like capitals, so Manrope hums as a flat gray sans-serif beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-montserrat: Montserrat glides under the eye, with white space leading into each curve and oversized e and a counters. Montserrat's steady pen pressure against Revalia's relaxed, widely separated stride is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-satoshi: Stencil bridges, big and loud. Snowburst One is at its best when letters are tall and the openings are wide, while Satoshi, a sans-serif with a soaring x-height and one stroke width, is best at staying open and easy.
gen-luckiest-guy-archivo: Luckiest Guy shouts cheerfully, its ink poured thick. Archivo then follows in sans-serif, its curves opening outward and its commanding x-height keeping paragraphs moving without any squeezing.
gen-gf-tektur-switzer: Distinctive from the first glance, Tektur stretches its lowercase to outsized proportions with pipe-cleaner strokes. But Switzer, a wire-like sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, is what gives the pair its strongest quality.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-work-sans: Work Sans sets a modern tone with a high mean line and joins as thick as its strokes. Work Sans, as sans-serif text, reads smoothly across a long passage beside Tilt Neon's tube-like heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-merriweather-sans: One enormous lowercase eye, drawn in a single thickness. Merriweather Sans stands sturdy beside it, with tall lowercase and open e shapes, making the two feel like a sharp sign next to a friendly sans.
